question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_qty AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_with_order AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id as inv_id,
        i.location_id,
        i.product_id,
        i.purchase_id,
        i.qty as inv_qty,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        p.purchased,
        o.total_qty as order_qty_needed,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) as rn,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cum_inv_qty
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN order_qty o ON i.product_id = o.product_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LAG(cum_inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn) as prev_cum_inv_qty
    FROM inventory_with_order
),
picked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_cum_inv_qty IS NULL OR prev_cum_inv_qty < order_qty_needed
            THEN LEAST(inv_qty, order_qty_needed - prev_cum_inv_qty)
            ELSE 0
        END as picked_qty
    FROM with_prev
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, picked_qty
FROM picked
WHERE picked_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, aisle, position
